en.headline: Hong Kong China International Tattoo Exhibition opens at Soho House
en.dek: More than 60 tattoo artists from Hong Kong and overseas gather at Sheung Wan’s Soho House from Friday to Sunday, with live work, an AI try-on feature and a competition on the final day.
body: The Hong Kong China International Tattoo Exhibition runs from 16 to 18 October at Soho House on Des Voeux Road West in Sheung Wan.

Organisers said more than 60 tattoo artists from Hong Kong, Japan, Korea, Europe and elsewhere are taking part. The event includes live tattooing, an AI try-on system developed by local company Oh My Ink that lets visitors preview designs, and live music.

A tattoo competition is scheduled for the final day across categories including black and grey, colour and old school. One-day tickets are listed at around HK$200 and a three-day pass at around HK$300, according to event listings.

zh.headline: 香港中國國際紋身展於上環Soho House開幕
zh.dek: 逾60位本地及海外紋身師周五至周日雲集上環德輔道西Soho House，有即場創作、AI試紋功能及最後一天比賽。
body: 香港中國國際紋身展由10月16日至18日在上環德輔道西Soho House舉行。
主辦方表示，超過60位來自香港、日本、韓國、歐洲等地的紋身師參與。活動包括即場紋身、本地公司Oh My Ink研發的AI試紋系統讓參觀者預覽設計，以及現場音樂表演。
最後一天設有紋身比賽，類別包括黑灰、彩色及舊學派等。活動資料顯示，單日門票約200港元，三日通票約300港元。
